title: 지방자치단체 보조금 관리에 관한 법률 시행규칙

rows.source_ko: Ministry of the Interior and Safety ( Financial Cooperation Division ), 044-205-3735, 3738
rows.text_en: Ministry of the Interior and Safety ( Financial Cooperation Division ), 044-205-3735, 3738

rows.source_ko: Article 1 (Purpose) The purpose of this ruleis to prescribe matters delegated by the Act on the Management of Subsidies by Local Governments and the Enforcement Decree of the same Act , as well as matters necessary for the implementation thereof.
rows.text_en: Article 1 (Purpose) The purpose of this Rule is to prescribe matters delegated by the Act on the Management of Subsidies by Local Governments and the Enforcement Decree of the same Act, as well as matters necessary for the implementation thereof.

rows.source_ko: Article 2 (Historical Management of Local Subsidies) ① The head of a local government shall prepare a Local Subsidy Project Management Card in accordance with Form No. 1 attached hereto, pursuant to Article 6, Paragraph 3 of the Act on the Management of Local Government Subsidies (hereinafter referred to as the “Act”). However, in the case of a local subsidy project for which a total of 1 million won or less in local subsidies is disbursed within the same fiscal year (applicable only to cases performed by an individual), a Local Subsidy Project Management Card for such project may not be prepared. <Amended Dec. 13, 2023>
rows.text_en: Article 2 (Historical Management of Local Subsidies) ① The head of a local government shall prepare a Local Subsidy Project Management Card in accordance with Form No. 1 attached hereto, pursuant to Article 6, Paragraph 3 of the Act on the Management of Subsidies by Local Governments (hereinafter referred to as the “Act”). However, in the case of a local subsidy project for which a total of 1 million won or less in local subsidies is disbursed within the same fiscal year (applicable only to cases performed by an individual), a Local Subsidy Project Management Card for such project may not be prepared. <Amended Dec. 13, 2023>

rows.source_ko: ② The head of a local government shall register and manage the local subsidy project management card under Paragraph 1 in the local subsidy integrated management network under Article 28 of the Act .
rows.text_en: ② The head of a local government shall register and manage the local subsidy project management card under Paragraph 1 in the local subsidy integrated management network under Article 28 of the Act .

rows.source_ko: Article 3 (Preparation of Performance Report, etc.) ①The format, method of preparation, and items of the performance report pursuant to the main text of the part other than the subparagraphs of Article 17 , Paragraph 1 of the Act shall be in accordance with Form No. 2 attached hereto . <Amended Dec. 13, 2023>
rows.text_en: Article 3 (Preparation of Performance Report, etc.) ①The format, method of preparation, and items of the performance report pursuant to the main text of the part other than the subparagraphs of Article 17 , Paragraph 1 of the Act shall be in accordance with Form No. 2 attached hereto . <Amended Dec. 13, 2023>

rows.source_ko: ② A local subsidy recipient shall submit the following documents attached to the performance report in Form No. 2 attached hereto to the head of the local government.
rows.text_en: ② A local subsidy recipient shall submit the following documents attached to the performance report in Form No. 2 attached hereto to the head of the local government.

rows.source_ko: 1. Local Subsidy Project Settlement Report ( Form No. 3)
rows.text_en: 1. Local Subsidy Project Settlement Report ( Form No. 3)

rows.source_ko: 2. Documents determined by the head of the local government pursuant to the latter part of the part other than each subparagraph of Article 17, Paragraph 1 of the Act
rows.text_en: 2. Documents determined by the head of the local government pursuant to the latter part of the part other than each subparagraph of Article 17, Paragraph 1 of the Act

rows.source_ko: Article 4 (Preparation of Verification-Related Reports, etc.) ① The format, method of preparation, and items of verification-related reports prescribed pursuant to Article 10, Paragraph 2 of the Enforcement Decree of the Act on the Management of Subsidies by Local Governments (hereinafter referred to as the “Decree”) shall be in accordance with Form No. 4 of the Attached Form. <Amended Dec. 13, 2023>
rows.text_en: Article 4 (Preparation of Verification-Related Reports, etc.) ① The format, method of preparation, and items of verification-related reports prescribed pursuant to Article 10, Paragraph 2 of the Enforcement Decree of the Act on the Management of Subsidies by Local Governments (hereinafter referred to as the “Decree”) shall be in accordance with Form No. 4 of the Attached Form. <Amended Dec. 13, 2023>

rows.source_ko: ② An auditor pursuant to Article 2, subparagraph 7 and Article 9 of the Act on External Audits of Corporations, etc. (hereinafter referred to as the “Auditor”) shall verify the following matters when preparing a verification-related report in Form No. 4 of the Attached Form .
rows.text_en: ② An auditor pursuant to Article 2, subparagraph 7 and Article 9 of the Act on External Audits of Corporations, etc. (hereinafter referred to as the “Auditor”) shall verify the following matters when preparing a verification-related report in Form No. 4 of the Attached Form .

rows.source_ko: 1. Certificates regarding the execution and expenditure of local government subsidies
rows.text_en: 1. Certificates regarding the execution and expenditure of local government subsidies

rows.source_ko: 2. Procedures for Concluding Local Subsidy Project Contracts and Adequacy of Related Supporting Documents
rows.text_en: 2. Procedures for Concluding Local Subsidy Project Contracts and Adequacy of Related Supporting Documents

rows.source_ko: 3. Project Plan for Local Subsidy Projects and Appropriateness of Local Subsidy Execution
rows.text_en: 3. Project Plan for Local Subsidy Projects and Appropriateness of Local Subsidy Execution

rows.source_ko: 4. Accuracy of interest calculation arising from local government subsidies
rows.text_en: 4. Accuracy of interest calculation arising from local government subsidies

rows.source_ko: 5. Whether the conditions for the disbursement of local subsidies pursuant to Article 9, Paragraph 1 of the Act have been violated, and the accuracy of the disallowed amount resulting from the violation
rows.text_en: 5. Whether the conditions for the disbursement of local subsidies pursuant to Article 9, Paragraph 1 of the Act have been violated, and the accuracy of the disallowed amount resulting from the violation

rows.source_ko: 6. In cases where the head of a local government has attached conditions regarding the return of all or part of local subsidies pursuant to Article 9, Paragraph 2 of the Act , the accuracy of the said return amount
rows.text_en: 6. In cases where the head of a local government has attached conditions regarding the return of all or part of local subsidies pursuant to Article 9, Paragraph 2 of the Act , the accuracy of the said return amount

rows.source_ko: 7. In cases where a portion of the local subsidy is carried over due to a change in the content of the local subsidy project or the allocation of expenses with the approval of the head of the local government pursuant to Article 14 of the Act , the accuracy of the carried-over amount
rows.text_en: 7. In cases where a portion of the local subsidy is carried over due to a change in the content of the local subsidy project or the allocation of expenses with the approval of the head of the local government pursuant to Article 14 of the Act , the accuracy of the carried-over amount

rows.source_ko: 8. Whether the documents prescribed by the head of the local government pursuant to the latter part of the part other than each subparagraph of Article 17, Paragraph 1 of the Act are provided
rows.text_en: 8. Whether the documents prescribed by the head of the local government pursuant to the latter part of the part other than each subparagraph of Article 17, Paragraph 1 of the Act are provided

rows.source_ko: 9. Unspent balance of local subsidies and accuracy of the amount of local subsidies returned pursuant to Article 9, Paragraph 3 of the Enforcement Decree
rows.text_en: 9. Unspent balance of local subsidies and accuracy of the amount of local subsidies returned pursuant to Article 9, Paragraph 3 of the Enforcement Decree

rows.source_ko: ③ 지방보조사업자는 법 제17조제1항 각 호의 사유가 발생한 경우에는 별지 제2호서식의 실적보고서 및 별지 제4호서식의 검증 관련 보고서(법 제17조제2항에 따라 검증 관련 보고서를 제출해야하는 경우에 한정한다)를 지방자치단체의 장에게 제출해야 한다.
rows.text_en: ③ In the event that any of the reasons specified in each subparagraph of Article 17, Paragraph 1 of the Act occur , the local subsidy recipient shall submit the performance report in Form No. 2 and the verification report in Form No. 4 (limited to cases where a verification report must be submitted pursuant to Article 17, Paragraph 2 of the Act ) to the head of the local government.

rows.source_ko: 제5조(특정지방보조사업자의 감사인 선정 등) ① 법 제18조제1항 본문에 따른 특정지방보조사업자(이하 “특정지방보조사업자”라 한다)는 영 제11조제1항에 따라 감사인을 선정하는 경우 해당 감사인과 감사계약을 체결한 날부터 1개월 이내에 그 선정 사실을 다음 각 호의 서류와 함께 지방자치단체의 장에게 통지해야 한다. 다만, 직전 감사 대상 사업연도에 선정한 감사인과 동일한 자를 감사인으로 선정한 경우에는 그 통지를 생략할 수 있다.
rows.text_en: Article 5 (Selection of Auditor, etc. by Specific Local Subsidy Operators) ①A specific local subsidy operator pursuant to the main text of Article 18, Paragraph 1 of the Act (hereinafter referred to as the “specific local subsidy operator”) shall, when selecting an auditor pursuant to Article 11, Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree, notify the head of the local government of the fact of such selection, together with the documents specified in each of the following subparagraphs, within one month from the date of concluding an audit contract with the said auditor. However, such notification may be omitted if the same person selected as the auditor in the immediately preceding audited fiscal year is selected as the auditor.

rows.source_ko: 1. 해당 감사인과의 감사계약서 사본
rows.text_en: 1. Copy of the audit agreement with the relevant auditor

rows.source_ko: 2. 해당 특정지방보조사업자의 법인등기부등본(특정지방보조사업자가 법인인 경우만 해당한다)
rows.text_en: 2. Certified copy of the corporate register of the relevant specific local subsidy recipient (applicable only if the specific local subsidy recipient is a corporation)

rows.source_ko: ② 특정지방보조사업자는 영 제11조제1항에 따라 선정한 감사인에게 다음 각 호의 어느 하나에 해당하는 사유가 발생한 경우에는 그 사유가 발생한 날부터 2개월 이내에 감사인을 새로 선정해야 한다.
rows.text_en: ② If any of the following causes occur to the auditor selected pursuant to Article 11, Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree, a specific local subsidy recipient must select a new auditor within two months from the date the cause occurred.

rows.source_ko: 1. 감사인인 회계법인이 파산 등의 사유로 해산한 경우. 다만, 합병ㆍ분할로 인하여 해산한 경우는 제외한다
rows.text_en: 1. Where the accounting firm serving as the auditor is dissolved due to reasons such as bankruptcy. However, cases of dissolution due to merger or division are excluded.

rows.source_ko: 2. 감사인인 회계법인 또는 「주식회사 등의 외부감사에 관한 법률」 제2조제7호나목에 따른 감사반(이하 “감사반”이라 한다)이 등록취소처분을 받은 경우
rows.text_en: 2. Where an accounting firm serving as the auditor or an audit team pursuant to Article 2, Subparagraph 7, Item B of the Act on External Audits of Corporations, etc. (hereinafter referred to as the “Audit Team”) receives a disposition of registration cancellation

rows.source_ko: 3. 감사인인 회계법인이 업무정지처분(감사반의 구성원이 직무정지처분을 받은 경우를 포함한다)을 받아 해당 사업연도의 회계감사가 불가능하게 된 경우
rows.text_en: 3. Where the accounting firm acting as the auditor receives a business suspension order (including cases where a member of the audit team receives a duty suspension order), making it impossible to conduct the accounting audit for the relevant fiscal year

rows.source_ko: 4. 감사인이 그 밖의 사유로 해당 사업연도의 회계감사를 사실상 수행할 수 없게 된 경우
rows.text_en: 4. Where the auditor becomes practically unable to perform the accounting audit for the relevant fiscal year due to other reasons

rows.source_ko: ③ 특정지방보조사업자는 감사인이 다음 각 호의 어느 하나에 해당하는 경우에는 지체 없이 감사인과의 감사계약을 해지하고, 그 감사계약을 해지한 날부터 2개월 이내에 감사인을 다시 선정해야 한다.
rows.text_en: ③ If the auditor falls under any of the following subparagraphs, the specific local subsidy recipient shall terminate the audit contract with the auditor without delay and select a new auditor within two months from the date of termination of the audit contract.

rows.source_ko: 1. 감사인이 「공인회계사법」 제21조 또는 제33조를 위반한 경우
rows.text_en: 1. If the auditor violates Article 21 or Article 33 of the Certified Public Accountants Act

rows.source_ko: 2. 감사인이 특정지방보조사업자의 기밀을 누설하는 등 직무상 의무를 위반한 경우
rows.text_en: 2. In cases where an auditor violates their official duties, such as by disclosing the confidential information of a specific local subsidy recipient

rows.source_ko: 3. 감사인이 그 의무를 게을리하여 특정지방보조사업자에게 손해를 입힌 경우
rows.text_en: 3. Cases where the auditor causes damage to a specific local subsidy recipient due to negligence of duty

rows.source_ko: 4. 감사인이 회계감사와 관련하여 부당한 요구를 하거나 압력을 행사한 경우
rows.text_en: 4. Where the auditor makes unreasonable demands or exercises pressure in connection with the accounting audit

rows.source_ko: ④ 지방자치단체의 장은 특정지방보조사업자가 영 제11조제1항에 따른 기한까지 감사인을 선정하지 않은 경우에는 해당 특정지방보조사업자에게 감사인을 선정할 것을 요구할 수 있다.
rows.text_en: ④ If a specific local subsidy recipient fails to select an auditor by the deadline under Article 11, Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree , the head of the local government may require the said specific local subsidy recipient to select an auditor.

rows.source_ko: ⑤ 지방자치단체의 장은 다음 각 호의 어느 하나에 해당하는 경우에는 해당 특정지방보조사업자에게 감사인을 변경할 것을 요구할 수 있다.
rows.text_en: ⑤ The head of a local government may require the relevant specific local subsidy recipient to change the auditor in any of the following cases.

rows.source_ko: 1. 특정지방보조사업자가 부당한 사유로 감사인을 교체했다고 판단되는 경우
rows.text_en: 1. Cases where it is determined that a specific local subsidy recipient replaced an auditor for improper reasons

rows.source_ko: 2. 제3항 각 호의 어느 하나에 해당함에도 불구하고 감사인을 다시 선정하지 않은 경우
rows.text_en: 2. In cases where an auditor is not re-selected despite falling under any of the subparagraphs of Paragraph 3

rows.source_ko: 제6조(감사보고서의 첨부서류 등) 영 제11조제3항 단서에 따라 감사인이 법 제18조제1항 본문에 따른 감사보고서(이하 “감사보고서”라 한다)에 첨부해야 하는 사항에 관한 서류의 작성서식은 별지 제5호서식에 따른다.
rows.text_en: Article 6 (Documents attached to the audit report, etc.) Pursuant to the proviso of Article 11, Paragraph 3 of the Enforcement Decree, the format for preparing documents regarding matters that an auditor must attach to the audit report pursuant to the main text of Article 18, Paragraph 1 of the Act (hereinafter referred to as the “audit report”) shall be in accordance with Form No. 5 of the Attached Form .

rows.source_ko: 제7조(중요재산의 부기등기) ① 지방보조사업자는 법 제22조제1항 각 호 외의 부분 본문에 따라 부기등기(附記登記)를 하려는 경우 별지 제6호서식의 지방보조금이 지원된 부동산증명서를 등기소에 제출해야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 7 (Supplementary Registration of Important Property) ① When a local subsidy recipientintends to make a supplementary registration in accordance with the main text of the part other than each subparagraph of Article 22, Paragraph 1 of the Act , they must submit a certificate of real estate supported by local subsidies in the form of Annex 6 to the registry office.

rows.source_ko: ② 지방보조사업자는 법 제22조제4항에 따라 부기등기를 말소하려는 경우에는 별지 제7호서식의 부기등기 말소 대상 부동산증명서를 등기소에 제출해야 한다.
rows.text_en: ② If a local subsidy recipient intends to cancel a supplementary registration pursuant to Article 22, Paragraph 4 of the Act , they must submit the Certificate of Real Estate Subject to Cancellation of Supplementary Registration in Form No. 7 of the Attached Form to the registry office.

rows.source_ko: 제8조(지방보조사업 수행 배제 등의 방법 및 절차) ① 영 제19조제5항제3호에서 “행정안전부령으로 정하는 사항”이란 해당 지방보조사업자 또는 지방보조금수령자(이하 “지방보조사업자등”이라 한다)의 지방보조사업의 수행을 배제하거나 지방보조금의 수급을 제한하는 기간을 말한다. <개정 2023. 12. 13.>
rows.text_en: Article 8 (Methods and Procedures for Exclusion from Execution of Local Subsidy Projects, etc.) ① In Article 19, Paragraph 5, Subparagraph 3 of the Enforcement Decree, “matters prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of the Interior and Safety” refers to the period during which the relevant local subsidy project operator or local subsidy recipient (hereinafter referred to as “local subsidy project operator, etc.”) is excluded from executing a local subsidy project or is restricted from receiving local subsidies. <Amended Dec. 13, 2023>

rows.source_ko: ② If a local subsidy recipient, etc. falls under any of the subparagraphs of Article 32 , Paragraph 1 or Paragraph 2 of the Act , the head of a local government shall notify the relevant local subsidy recipient, etc. of the reasons for exclusion from performing the local subsidy project or restriction on the disbursement of local subsidies and the period pursuant to Paragraph 1, and shall give them an opportunity to explain within a period of 15 days from the date of such notification.
rows.text_en: ② If a local subsidy recipient, etc. falls under any of the subparagraphs of Article 32 , Paragraph 1 or Paragraph 2 of the Act , the head of a local government shall notify the relevant local subsidy recipient, etc. of the reasons for exclusion from performing the local subsidy project or restriction on the disbursement of local subsidies and the period pursuant to Paragraph 1, and shall give them an opportunity to explain within a period of 15 days from the date of such notification.

rows.source_ko: ③ If the head of a local government deems that the result of a court trial is necessary to make a decision to exclude a local subsidy recipient, etc. from the execution of a local subsidy project or to restrict the receipt of a local subsidy, he/she may temporarily suspend the proceedings concerning the exclusion from the execution of the local subsidy project or the restriction on the receipt of a local subsidy. In this case, the head of the local government shall notify the local subsidy recipient, etc. of the fact that the proceedings have been temporarily suspended.
rows.text_en: ③ If the head of a local government deems that the result of a court trial is necessary to make a decision to exclude a local subsidy recipient, etc. from the execution of a local subsidy project or to restrict the receipt of a local subsidy, he/she may temporarily suspend the proceedings concerning the exclusion from the execution of the local subsidy project or the restriction on the receipt of a local subsidy. In this case, the head of the local government shall notify the local subsidy recipient, etc. of the fact that the proceedings have been temporarily suspended.

rows.source_ko: Article 9 (Procedure for Imposing Sanction Surcharges) Whenthe head of a local government intends to provide written notice of the imposition and collection of sanction surcharges pursuant to Article 21, Paragraph 3 of the Enforcement Decree, he/she shall issue a notice of payment in the form of Annex 8 and send it to the relevant local subsidy recipient, etc. by means such as mail.
rows.text_en: Article 9 (Procedure for Imposing Sanction Surcharges) When the head of a local government intends to provide written notice of the imposition and collection of sanction surcharges pursuant to Article 21, Paragraph 3 of the Enforcement Decree, he/she shall issue a notice of payment in the form of Annex 8 and send it to the relevant local subsidy recipient, etc. by means such as mail.

rows.source_ko: Article 2 (Applicability to Exceptions to the Preparation of Local Subsidy Project Management Cards)  The amended provisions of the proviso to Article 2, Paragraph 1 shall apply to local subsidy projects for which the disbursement of local subsidies has been decided pursuant to Article 8, Paragraph 1 of the Act after the enforcement of this Rule.
rows.text_en: Article 2 (Applicability to Exceptions to the Preparation of Local Subsidy Project Management Cards)  The amended provisions of the proviso to Article 2, Paragraph 1 shall apply to local subsidy projects for which the disbursement of local subsidies has been decided pursuant to Article 8, Paragraph 1 of the Act after the enforcement of this Rule.
